name: fhevm-agent-skill
description: FHEVM Agent Safety and Development Skill

scripts.compile: set APPDATA=.hardhat-appdata&& set LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-localappdata&& hardhat compile
scripts.test: set APPDATA=.hardhat-appdata&& set LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-localappdata&& hardhat test test/Artifacts.test.ts
scripts.test:counter: set APPDATA=.hardhat-appdata&& set LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-localappdata&& hardhat test test/Artifacts.test.ts --grep ConfidentialCounter
scripts.test:token: set APPDATA=.hardhat-appdata&& set LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-localappdata&& hardhat test test/Artifacts.test.ts --grep ConfidentialERC7984Token
scripts.test:auction: set APPDATA=.hardhat-appdata&& set LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-localappdata&& hardhat test test/Artifacts.test.ts --grep BlindAuction
scripts.demo: set APPDATA=.hardhat-appdata&& set LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-localappdata&& hardhat run demo/demo.ts --network hardhat
scripts.clean: set APPDATA=.hardhat-appdata&& set LOCALAPPDATA=.hardhat-localappdata&& hardhat clean
